title: Parsing with std::optional
hints: `parse_int`: walk the string by index. Note an optional leading `'-'`, require at least one character after it, then every remaining character must be `'0'`..`'9'`. Accumulate the magnitude in a `long long` and `return std::nullopt` as soon as it exceeds the `int` limit (`2147483647`, or `2147483648` when negative). Do not wait until the end: a 20-digit string overflows `long long` too, and signed overflow is undefined behavior.
